description: This file contains migration rules and functions for legacy channel configuration settings, including stream modes, thread bindings, and allow/enabled toggles, for a messaging platform configuration system.

methods.name: hasOwnKey
methods.description: Checks if a target object has a specific key as its own property.

methods.name: normalizeStreamingMode
methods.description: Normalizes a streaming mode value to lowercase string or null.

methods.name: parseStreamingMode
methods.description: Parses a value into a StreamingMode type if valid.

methods.name: parseDiscordPreviewStreamMode
methods.description: Parses a value into a DiscordPreviewStreamMode, with special handling for 'progress'.

methods.name: parseTelegramPreviewStreamMode
methods.description: Parses a value into a TelegramPreviewStreamMode, with special handling for 'progress'.

methods.name: parseSlackLegacyDraftStreamMode
methods.description: Parses a value into a SlackLegacyDraftStreamMode.

methods.name: mapSlackLegacyDraftStreamModeToStreaming
methods.description: Maps SlackLegacyDraftStreamMode to a StreamingMode.

methods.name: resolveTelegramPreviewStreamMode
methods.description: Resolves Telegram preview stream mode based on parameters, with fallback logic.

methods.name: resolveDiscordPreviewStreamMode
methods.description: Resolves Discord preview stream mode based on parameters, with fallback logic.

methods.name: resolveSlackStreamingMode
methods.description: Resolves Slack streaming mode based on parameters, with fallback logic.

methods.name: resolveSlackNativeStreaming
methods.description: Determines native streaming boolean value based on parameters.

methods.name: formatSlackStreamModeMigrationMessage
methods.description: Formats a migration message for streamMode to streaming.

methods.name: formatSlackStreamingBooleanMigrationMessage
methods.description: Formats a migration message for streaming boolean to nativeStreaming.

methods.name: hasLegacyThreadBindingTtl
methods.description: Checks if a value has legacy thread binding TTL key.

methods.name: hasLegacyThreadBindingTtlInAccounts
methods.description: Checks if any account has legacy thread binding TTL.

methods.name: migrateThreadBindingsTtlHoursForPath
methods.description: Migrates TTL hours to idle hours in thread bindings, updating the object and recording changes.

methods.name: hasLegacyThreadBindingTtlInAnyChannel
methods.description: Checks if any channel or account has legacy thread binding TTL.

methods.name: hasLegacyTelegramStreamingKeys
methods.description: Checks if an object has legacy Telegram stream mode keys.

methods.name: hasLegacyDiscordStreamingKeys
methods.description: Checks if an object has legacy Discord stream mode or streaming keys.

methods.name: hasLegacySlackStreamingKeys
methods.description: Checks if an object has legacy Slack stream mode or streaming keys.

methods.name: hasLegacyGoogleChatStreamMode
methods.description: Checks if an object has legacy Google Chat stream mode.

methods.name: hasLegacyKeysInAccounts
methods.description: Checks if any account in a collection matches a specific legacy key condition.

methods.name: hasLegacyAllowAlias
methods.description: Checks if an entry has a legacy 'allow' key.

methods.name: migrateAllowAliasForPath
methods.description: Migrates legacy 'allow' key to 'enabled' and records change message.

methods.name: hasLegacySlackChannelAllowAlias
methods.description: Checks if Slack channels have legacy allow alias.

methods.name: hasLegacyGoogleChatGroupAllowAlias
methods.description: Checks if Google Chat groups have legacy allow alias.

methods.name: hasLegacyDiscordGuildChannelAllowAlias
methods.description: Checks if Discord guild channels have legacy allow alias.
